Nivel de vechime: Începător
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Servicii de resurse umane
We are looking for a Field & Integration Engineer to join the Engineering Team, supporting advanced defense and control systems.
 Not looking for a traditional office job? If you enjoy hands-on engineering, solving technical challenges in real-world environments, and travelling as part of your work, this role might be a great fit.
 You will support complex systems from integration and testing to troubleshooting, deployment,
 commissioning, and operations, working across laboratories, production facilities, test sites, and
 customer locations. Frequent travel within Romania and internationally is an integral part of the role. 
 What you will be doing: 
 • Perform system integration for complex systems and subsystems.
 • Install, configure, and verify hardware and software components.
 • Carry out laboratory tests, system tests, customer acceptance tests, and validation activities.
 • Support system deployment, installation, commissioning, and field operations.
 • Troubleshoot hardware, software, and system-level issues, identifying root causes and supporting their resolution.
 • Participate in field demonstrations, system evaluations, and customer acceptance activities.
 • Collaborate with Software, Hardware, System Engineering, Production, and Project Management teams.
 • Prepare integration reports, test reports, and technical documentation.
 • Document activities, issues, and progress according to company tools and procedures.
 • Support international projects and customer sites during deployment and operational phases.
 • Train and support operators, maintainers, and customer representatives when required.
 What we are looking for: 
 Technical must-haves 
 • Relevant technical studies in Electronics, Electrical Engineering, Computer Systems, Mechanical Systems, or a related field.
 • Hands-on experience in system integration, system testing, field engineering, technical support, or a similar role.
 • Ability to understand technical documentation, drawings, system specifications, and test procedures.
 • Experience working with multidisciplinary systems that combine hardware, software, and
 communication components.
 • Hands-on skills in installation, integration, testing, and troubleshooting.
 • Excellent written and verbal English.
 • Valid driver’s license.
 • Availability to work in laboratories, test sites, production facilities, and customer locations.
 The mindset and soft skills 
 • Highly motivated and eager to learn.
 • Hands-on and technically minded.
 • Strong ownership and accountability.
 • Analytical and solution-oriented.
 • Comfortable working independently and making decisions in the field.
 • Strong interpersonal and teamwork skills.
 • Organized, structured, and detail-oriented.
 • Flexible and adaptable to changing operational requirements.
 • Comfortable working with multiple stakeholders in a multidisciplinary environment.
 Nice to have 
 • Up to 3 years of experience in system integration, testing, field engineering, or technical support.
 • Military service in a technical, operational, maintenance, or defense systems-related role.
 • Experience with defense, industrial, or automotive systems.
 • FAT, SAT, and customer acceptance testing experience.
 • Experience deploying and commissioning systems at customer sites.
 • Experience with test equipment and measurement instruments.
 • Experience installing, configuring, and troubleshooting complex systems.
 • Familiarity with automation tools.
 • Experience working with international customers and suppliers.
 • Additional language skills.
